name: Rituparna Khan

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Rituparna Khan writes poetry and fiction alongside her work in geography education. Her books include the short-story collection Tales Told and Untold, the poetry collection Melting Thoughts: Emotion in Motion and the novella Homecoming. Her writing also appears in literary journals such as Setu.

“Book forest” imagines writing as an ecosystem grown from the contrasting flavours of experience. “Ballad of the Land of Isis” follows a childhood fascination into an imagined return through Egypt’s landscapes and monuments. The short pieces gathered under “Wall decors” turn instead towards estrangement, obligation and the value of the present moment.
